item.title: WebDAV with Rclone and mTLS
item.description: WebDAV is an open extension to the HTTP protocol that lets you treat a web server like a remote filesystem. Rclone is an open source WebDAV client that lets you mount remote volumes for read/write access on your local computer. Provision your WebDAV server You can use any WebDAV server that you have access to. If you need to install one, I recommend copyparty or nextcloud (Use the d.rymcg.tech distribution to install these on Docker.
